	@_Number INT = 1000,
	@_Type NVARCHAR(64) = 'P'
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT *
	FROM sys.objects
		WHERE type = @_Type
			AND DATEDIFF(D,modify_date, GETDATE()) <= @_Number
		ORDER BY modify_date DESC, Create_Date DESC
